chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
The brisk movement (walking) in the valley of Muhassar is one hundred steps.
ai.seo_question: What is the length of the valley of Muhassar in steps according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the specific measure of 'Muhassar' as one hundred paces, a detail crucial for understanding the ritual brisk-walking (Qad') performed by pilgrims during Hajj. In Shia scholarly tradition, this precise measurement underscores the importance of adhering to the Sunnah of the Prophet and the Imams in replicating the exact manner of the Prophet's final pilgrimage.
